findings.location: Sidebar category navigation links on the left panel (e.g., 'Travel', 'Mystery')
findings.issue: The light blue link text on the light gray sidebar background does not meet the WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.user_impact: Visually impaired users will find the category sidebar illegible, severely hindering navigation.
findings.recommendation: Change the text color of the sidebar links to a darker blue (such as #1a5a96) to ensure a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the light gray background.

findings.location: Warning banner at the top of the main content area
findings.issue: The dark yellow/brown warning text on the pale yellow alert background fails the WCAG AA contrast requirement of 4.5:1.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision or screen glare may struggle to read or entirely miss this important website disclaimer.
findings.recommendation: Increase the contrast by using a darker foreground color (such as #664d03) on the warning alert background.

findings.location: Book titles under each book cover image in the grid
findings.issue: Titles are prematurely truncated with ellipses (e.g., 'A Light in the ...'), hiding essential product information.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot determine the full name of a book without clicking through to the detail page, causing unnecessary friction while browsing.
findings.recommendation: Allow book titles to wrap to a second line instead of truncating them immediately on a single line, and enforce a fixed height for the title container to maintain grid alignment.

findings.location: Book cover images across the product grid
findings.issue: The book cover images have inconsistent aspect ratios and dimensions, causing uneven spacing, misaligned elements below them, and visual clutter.
findings.user_impact: The uneven visual layout makes the product grid feel unpolished and harder for users to scan comfortably.
findings.recommendation: Apply a standardized container with fixed dimensions (e.g., height of 200px) for all book cover images and use CSS 'object-fit: contain' to ensure consistent grid alignment.
